notes.title: Early Access Release
notes.notes:
Early Access is now available.

Please try the demo first if you're thinking of buying the game. Progress will carry over

notes.title: Last update before EA
notes.notes:
Last update for EA launch

0.2.4
- Limited decal offsets to part sizes
- Added a Modify node step to tutorial
- Added "Search Nodes" to coder drone context menu (right click). Will search codes (dispatcher/listener), variables (if used in inputs or saving outputs), and comments
- Added "Pass Inherited Through" option to Read and Modify nodes, toggling this to true will pass the value they inherited through instead of their output
- Took another shot at an obstacle avoiding drone for the "new drone" presets

0.2.5
- Nerfed Alpha6 to 2 enemies (were 3)
- Added social links to title page

notes.title: I lied, patch 0.2.3
notes.notes:
Next one is going to be the last before EA for sure...

0.2.1
- Color coded parts
- Color coded drones (by main color)
- Added level intro transition
- UI chips with no code have a darker background

0.2.2
- Added undo/redo functionality in Builder and Coder (Ctrl+Z/Y)

0.2.3
- Added a simulating indicator
- Added a list of listeners listening to a dispatcher, and vice versa
- Changed part order

notes.title: Penultimate Demo update before EA
notes.notes:
0.2.0
- News window at title screen if news is available
- New arena fighter placements
- Added drone part pooling
- Changed Listeners to only listen to the same scope (local/global/area)
- Modification slots only appear if the part is selected
- Indicators added for newly unlocked parts
- Improved simulation time
- Misc bug fixes

notes.title: Last Update before EA
notes.notes:
0.1.17
- Some tutorial clarifications
- Mouse drag part turning

0.1.18
- Part turning sound effects
- Added accent highlights for certain actions (firing weapons and such)
- Buffed extension stats
- Dashed the perimeter circle

0.1.19
- Moved some tutorial prompts
- Added preset drones to "New Drone" options
- Fixed certain obstacle collisions
- Added some flavor rocks to Alpha

0.1.20
- Changed drone slot graphics
- Added numbers to duplicate programmable part names
- Added flavor elements to Bravo and Charlie
- Added team details to battle summary
- A bunch of new parts, not yet obtainable
- Added a Prep stat (= cast time)

This is the last update until Early Access drops on 1/11/24. It feels like it's in decent shape except for being beginner unfriendly.

notes.title: Another Demo update (and EA prep)
notes.notes:
0.1.15
- Added nameplate toggle (N)
- Added team 5 and 6 to sandbox
- Text changes for outcomes to "T" and "F"
- 7 Steam achievements
- Changed drone arena placement logic, should be less annoying
- Added "remove all fighters" (from arena) option for drones in coder
- OnDestroyed node returns part id if value is set to inherited
- Added part id stat, can be retrieved with Read node -> Get Statistic -> ID, is also in stat list
- OnCpUCycle returns the number of cycles initiated if value is set to inherited
- Added OnGotHit (obstacle), and (fighter) to part read node
- OnGotHit (projectile, obstacle, fighter) returns the angle of the hit if value is set to inherited

0.1.16
- Rollovers for drones in simulation view reflect drone/portrait
- Added pvp level imports into sandbox
- Added a random drone carousel to title screen

notes.title: New demo patch out
notes.notes:
Data was reset once again, could have one more before early access

0.1.13
- New weapon type - S, only attachable to body
- Added shadow toggle to quality settings
- Added visual slot offsets
- Added sandbox reset
- Added decals to special parts

0.1.14
- Moved deployer objectives
- Modified missile explosion behavior
- Reduced missile lifetime by 1s
- Added OnDestroyed event operation, one outcome limit
- Implemented object pooling for UI
- Changed special weapons to only affect hostile drones
- Separated drones to invidual save files
- Added obstacle cloning
- New stages/levels/items/objectives (beyond demo, can still try in sandbox)
- Rebalanced levels
- Renamed parts
- Removed splash screen

notes.title: Big Demo Update
notes.notes:
0.1.12

- Data was reset (there might be one more before early access)
- New tutorial
- Added tutorial skip / home page shortcut (F5)
- Added values and variable saves to event nodes
- Added power input for moving and turning, removed "Stop Movement" operation
- Reduced time step from 1/60 to 1/100
- Added default values for node value inputs
- Added false paths for Read nodes if object is not found
- Updated modify "=" to be more clear
- Added _x and _y location of drone to default variables
- Added visual bases to weapons
- Added Get Location operation to Body (distance or angle to x,y)
- Added Energy and Energy Regeneration to Engine
- Added new part type: Special (charges)
- Added new part type: Converter (energy from engine)
- Added false paths to Dispatch nodes if no listeners are found
- Added 4 more levels with new item progression
- Added new default body
- Added npc only slots (will be added as needed)

notes.title: Demo Update 4
notes.notes:
Some patches that I didn't post here yet:

0.1.4
- Expanding windows (added an animation for new window opening)
- New battle summary window
- New part connections (prettied up connections with parts, took out the gaps)

0.1.5
- DB loading spinner (shows a spinner when getting data from the database)
- Impact stat for core parts (increases or decreases damage dealt when impacting with other drones)
- Fitting drones into windows (larger drones should fit fine into windows such as rollover preview)
- Added new objectives and items
- Rollovers for arena drones (highlights drones when rolling over them in the arena or in the UI)

0.1.6
- New connecting disk (added a new model at part connections to hide gaps)
- Added a tutorial intro
- New tutorial window animation (expands horizontally to increase visibility)

0.1.7
- Added debug line to operations (most "read" operations have an option to add a debug line, for... debugging)
- Fixed many read operation bugs
- Updated default user MMR to 1,500 (i forgot to set this above 0, sorry to anyone who participated in pvp so far, all 2 of you)

notes.title: Demo Update 3
notes.notes:
- Added leaderboards to PvE (time) and PvP (rating)
- Added new locations for sandbox drones
- Added toggle for temporary chip visibility (V)

Saved data was erased for this patch. Sorry to anyone coming back. Shouldn't happen again.

notes.title: Demo Update 2
notes.notes:
- Added Japanese and Korean language support for inputs and usernames
- Added more sandbox level settings and import/export capability
